verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both clauses are stated, in two declarations, after two routine rewritings. (i) FlatCutoff.edge 4 δ = Real.exp (-4 / δ^2) for δ > 0 (FlatCutoff.edge_of_pos, NavierStokes/FlatCutoff.lean:34); for δ ≤ 0 the Lean edge is 0, where the paper's e^{-4/δ²}δ^{-3} is undefined anyway. (ii) The Lean profile point is y = (η, δ) with y.1 = η and y.2 = δ, so the paper's b_θ(δ,η) is profileAngularFactor C d y0 (η, δ), the arguments in the other order; with that, (FlatCutoff.edge 4 δ / δ^3) * b_θ is literally e^{-4/δ²}δ^{-3}b_θ(δ,η). The positivity clause b_θ(0,η) > 0 is a separate declaration carrying the hypotheses 0 < C and η ∈ Icc (-1) 1, the latter being the Lean's normalised version of the paper's compact parameter range for η.
